title: Hardness of Heart
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Hardness of heart is a stubborn, resistant condition in which a person becomes dull, unmoved, and unresponsive to God’s Word, warnings, mercy, or correction. It is a serious effect of sin and unbelief.
summary: Hardness of heart is a stubborn, resistant condition in which a person becomes dull, unmoved, and unresponsive to God’s Word, warnings, mercy, or correction. It is a serious effect of sin and unbelief.
christFocus: Jesus Christ exposes hard hearts and gives new hearts by His grace. Through Him, sinners who were stubborn and resistant can be softened, forgiven, and made responsive to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Hardness of heart develops when people resist God’s voice. Scripture warns believers not to harden their hearts when they hear the Lord speaking. Repeated unbelief and disobedience can make the soul increasingly resistant.

A hard heart may appear as indifference, stubbornness, bitterness, refusal to repent, contempt for correction, or spiritual dullness. It may remain religious outwardly while inwardly resisting God.

Hardness is dangerous because the person may stop feeling the seriousness of sin. What once convicted the heart can become easy to ignore. This is why Scripture calls people to respond today and not delay repentance.

God alone can replace the heart of stone with a heart of flesh. The hope for hard-hearted sinners is not self-softening, but the mercy of God in Christ and the renewing work of the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Delayed obedience is not spiritually neutral. The more truth is resisted, the easier resistance can become. This doctrine warns people not to treat conviction casually.

It also gives hope to families, churches, and individuals praying for hardened people. God can break through resistance and give a new heart where human persuasion cannot.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Respond to God’s Word while it is called today. Do not delay repentance, excuse bitterness, or resist correction. Ask God to soften your heart, receive His warnings as mercy, and encourage others gently before sin hardens them further.
